candidate.definition_en: The borders or boundaries of a place (usually plural 'confines').
candidate.explanation_ar: حدود أو نطاق مكان معين (غالباً بتيجي جمع Confines).

senses.definition_en: The borders or boundaries of a place (usually plural 'confines').
senses.explanation_ar: حدود أو نطاق مكان معين (غالباً بتيجي جمع Confines).
examples: The prisoner paced within the narrow confine of his cell.
He struggled against the rigid confine of social expectations.
The author felt restricted by the strict confine of the genre.
